# Weeknight Lemon-Herb Chicken

This bright, simple tray-bake pairs juicy chicken with potatoes and green beans. Fresh lemon,
garlic, and herbs make a flavorful pan sauce, while the vegetables cook alongside the meat.
It is a useful dinner for a busy evening because preparation takes about fifteen minutes and
the oven does most of the work. The recipe serves four people and can be doubled for a larger
gathering if you use two baking trays.

Prep: 15 minutes. Cook: 35 minutes. Serves: 4.

## Ingredients

- 4 boneless chicken thighs, about 600 g total

- 500 g baby potatoes, halved

- 200 g trimmed green beans

- 1 lemon, zested and cut into wedges

- 2 tablespoons olive oil, 2 crushed garlic cloves, and 1 teaspoon dried oregano

- ½ teaspoon salt and freshly ground black pepper

## Method

- Heat the oven to 190°C. Line a large tray with baking paper and arrange the potatoes in
one layer. Toss them with half the oil, salt, and pepper.

- Mix the remaining oil with garlic, oregano, lemon zest, and a squeeze of lemon juice.
Coat the chicken in this mixture, then nestle the pieces between the potatoes.

- Bake for 25 minutes. Add the green beans and lemon wedges, turning the potatoes once so
they brown evenly. Return the tray to the oven for about 10 minutes, until the chicken is
cooked through and the potatoes are tender.

- Rest the chicken for five minutes before serving. Spoon the warm lemon juices over each
portion and bring the tray to the table.

Serving idea: Add a green salad or crusty bread to catch the pan juices.
Leftovers keep covered in the refrigerator for up to two days; reheat them until steaming.
If using chicken breasts, check them early because thinner pieces may finish sooner.

# Returns and refunds

We want household goods to work well in your home. If an unused item is not right for you,
you may return it within 30 days of delivery for a refund to the original payment method.
Items should be packed securely with their accessories and order slip. A return label can
be created from the order history page, or printed at a parcel shop using the return code
shown there. Please keep the drop-off receipt until the parcel has been checked in.

## Starting a return

- Open your order history and choose the item you want to send back.

- Select a reason so our team can improve product descriptions and packaging.

- Attach the label to the parcel and take it to any listed collection point.

## Refund timing

After a return reaches our warehouse, staff inspect it within five business days. Approved
refunds are then issued to the original payment method. Banks and card providers may take
several additional days to show the credit on a statement. If the refund has not appeared
after ten business days, check with your provider before opening a second request.

## Items with a problem

Damaged or faulty goods are handled separately from a change-of-mind return. Contact the
support team within 14 days of delivery and include a clear description of the problem.
Do not discard the packaging until the team confirms whether it is needed for assessment.
This shorter contact period does not reduce any rights provided by local consumer law.

## Not eligible for return

Personalized goods, opened hygiene products, and gift cards cannot be returned unless they
arrive faulty. For bulky furniture, arrange collection before sending anything back; the
return desk will explain the available options and any collection charge. Orders paid with
a gift voucher are refunded as a new voucher for the eligible amount.

Hearthside Supply - Practical goods for home and garden
